title: Neurotic Manipulations
subtitle: Ductilis — the nerve of blood
text: Ductilis carries coordination through blood. Activation Potential disrupts a target; Sanguine Ward shields its caster. At Degree Six, Axonal Transduction (PASSIVE, 150 mL per entry) turns the practitioner into a living impulse. Weave a Naeglerophaeon Ganglion beside a blank Hematic Memory with four Neurotic enzymes and 600 mL blood. Absorb the memory in an Iron Brazier. Enable the passive, then touch a Synaptic Node to enter connected Nerve Fibers or Bundles. Hold forward to travel toward where you look, press backward to travel away, release to stop, and look into a branch to choose it. Sneak bypasses entry or slows travel. Another node releases you into clear space. Travel has no upkeep or time limit, but broken fibers stop the run. You cannot attack, cast, or work blocks while dissolved.
